# botyard_pack_version (Data Source)

Reads the full contents of one bot-pack version: its skills (with pinned skill versions), tools, connections, settings and soul.

Address the version by `pack_version_id`, or by `slug` for the pack's latest published version. The API cannot look up an older version by number, so pin an older version by its id.

Versions of archived packs stay readable by id and have `pack_archived = true`.

`skill_ids` and `tool_ids` list every skill and tool the version names, required or not. Use them with `setunion` in `botyard_bot_skill_assignment` and `botyard_bot_tool_assignment`, which are exclusive and would otherwise remove pack items from a bot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the latest version of a pack by slug...
data "botyard_pack_version" "crm" {
  slug = "crm-assistant"
}

# ...or pin an exact version by id.
data "botyard_pack_version" "crm_pinned" {
  pack_version_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

# botyard_bot_skill_assignment is exclusive, so a bot's own skills must be
# merged with the pack's. Otherwise the pack's skills would be removed.
resource "botyard_bot_skill_assignment" "example" {
  bot_slug  = botyard_bot.example.slug
  skill_ids = setunion(data.botyard_pack_version.crm.skill_ids, [data.botyard_skill.extra.id])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `pack_version_id` (String) Id (UUID) of the version to read. Exactly one of `pack_version_id` and `slug` is required.
- `slug` (String) Slug of a catalogue pack whose latest published version to read. Exactly one of `pack_version_id` and `slug` is required. Fails, listing the candidates, if the slug names more than one pack (a Botyard pack and your organization's own may share a slug); use `pack_version_id` then.

### Read-Only

- `avatar_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the version's avatar image.
- `avatar_url` (String) URL of the version's avatar image.
- `changelog` (String) What changed in this version. Null when none was given.
- `connections` (Attributes List) Connections the version asks the installer for. `kind` says which one of `mcp_catalog_entry` and `vault_secret` is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connections))
- `content_hash` (String) Hash of the version's contents.
- `created_at` (String) When the version was published (RFC 3339).
- `description_md` (String) Long description, in Markdown.
- `is_latest` (Boolean) Whether this is the pack's latest published version.
- `name` (String) Display name of this version.
- `pack_archived` (Boolean) Whether the pack is archived. Its versions stay readable and installed bots keep working.
- `pack_id` (String) Id of the pack this version belongs to.
- `publisher_org_id` (String) Organization that publishes the pack. Null for platform-curated packs.
- `recommended_model` (Attributes) The model the pack recommends. Null when it recommends none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recommended_model))
- `settings` (Attributes) Bot settings the pack applies. A null field means the pack does not set it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))
- `skill_ids` (Set of String) Ids of every skill in `skills`.
- `skills` (Attributes List) Skills the version includes, each pinned to a skill version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--skills))
- `soul` (String) The soul (system instructions) the pack gives a bot.
- `start_with_default_tools` (Boolean) Whether a bot created from this version also gets the platform's suggested default tools. No effect when installing onto an existing bot.
- `summary` (String) One-line summary of this version.
- `tool_ids` (Set of String) Ids of every tool in `tools`.
- `tools` (Attributes List) Tools the version includes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tools))
- `version_no` (Number) Version number, counting from 1.
- `visibility` (String) Who may see the pack: `curated`, `org_private` or `public`.

<a id="nestedatt--connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connections`

Read-Only:

- `kind` (String) `mcp_catalog_entry` or `vault_secret`.
- `mcp_catalog_entry` (Attributes) The MCP catalogue entry to connect. Set only when `kind` is `mcp_catalog_entry`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connections--mcp_catalog_entry))
- `purpose` (String) What the connection is for. Null when not given.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the pack needs this connection.
- `vault_secret` (Attributes) The Runtime Vault secret the installer supplies. Set only when `kind` is `vault_secret`. Never contains a value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connections--vault_secret))

<a id="nestedatt--connections--mcp_catalog_entry"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connections.mcp_catalog_entry`

Read-Only:

- `mcp_catalog_entry_id` (String) MCP catalogue entry id.
- `name` (String) Catalogue entry name.
- `slug` (String) Catalogue entry slug.
- `tool_names` (List of String) Tools of the server the pack uses. Null means all of them.


<a id="nestedatt--connections--vault_secret"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connections.vault_secret`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) What the secret is for. Null when not given.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `key_path` (String) Vault key path the secret is stored at.
- `max_ttl_seconds` (Number) Maximum lease TTL bots may request.
- `sensitivity` (String) `secret` or `plain`.



<a id="nestedatt--recommended_model"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recommended_model`

Read-Only:

- `model` (String) Model id within the provider.
- `provider` (String) Model provider key (e.g. `botyard`).


<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Read-Only:

- `reasoning_default` (String) Default reasoning mode (`off`, `on` or `stream`).
- `thinking_default` (String) Default thinking level.
- `tool_images` (Attributes) Tool-image settings. Null when the pack does not set them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--tool_images))
- `tool_search` (Attributes) Tool Search settings. Null when the pack does not set them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--tool_search))

<a id="nestedatt--settings--tool_images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.tool_images`

Read-Only:

- `default_detail` (String) Default image detail level.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether tool images are shown to the model.
- `max_dimension_px` (Number) Longest edge tool images are downscaled to.


<a id="nestedatt--settings--tool_search"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.tool_search`

Read-Only:

- `auto_threshold_percent` (Number) Context-window percentage above which `auto` defers tool schemas.
- `mode` (String) `always`, `auto` or `off`.



<a id="nestedatt--skills"></a>
### Nested Schema for `skills`

Read-Only:

- `required` (Boolean) Whether the pack needs this skill.
- `skill_id` (String) Skill id. Use with `botyard_bot_skill_assignment`.
- `skill_name` (String) Skill name.
- `skill_slug` (String) Skill slug.
- `skill_version_id` (String) Id of the pinned skill version.
- `version_name` (String) Name of the pinned skill version.
- `version_no` (Number) Number of the pinned skill version.


<a id="nestedatt--tools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tools`

Read-Only:

- `mcp` (Attributes) MCP details. Set only when `runtime` is `mcp`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tools--mcp))
- `name` (String) Tool name.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the pack needs this tool.
- `runtime` (String) Where the tool runs: `mcp` (served over MCP), or `openclaw` / `native` (built into the bot's runtime).
- `slug` (String) Tool slug.
- `title` (String) Tool title. Null when the tool has none.
- `tool_id` (String) Tool id. Use with `botyard_bot_tool_assignment`.

<a id="nestedatt--tools--mcp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tools.mcp`

Read-Only:

- `server` (String) MCP server the tool comes from, as the tool catalogue names it (e.g. `botyard`).
